# NAT Troubleshooting

When NAT does not behave as expected, verify:

1. Incoming interface
2. Source zone
3. Destination zone
4. NAT rule-set scope
5. NAT rule order
6. Source address match
7. Destination address match
8. Protocol match
9. Port match
10. Translation pool
11. Security policy
12. Routing
13. Return path
14. Session table
15. Logs

---
